implementationPolicy: A validated Last War root may rebind the existing Overview lifecycle only at a stopped, same-profile journal-free boundary. An active launch/running/stop/recovery/repair-owned session remains bound to its original root until exact cleanup/restoration finishes. Re-selecting the same root is a persistence-only no-op.

implementation: SaveGameRoot validates without mutating configuration, then atomically coordinates persistence and lifecycle root replacement.
Rebind rejects root changes while starting, running, stopping, helper-owned or recovery-owned work is active.
A same-profile pending recovery journal blocks root replacement until cleanup/restoration is complete; malformed/unreadable journal state fails closed.
Same-root reselection remains a harmless persistence-only no-op.
StartAsync captures the selected root while holding lifecycle state ownership and validates the helper result against that exact root.
A lifecycle created with no valid root can start its recovery monitor after a later valid selection.
Game process status no longer accepts any same-named LastWar/launcher process when no validated expected path exists.
